source_contract: Restore a backup predating an acknowledged mutation, activate a new history incarnation, and advance its clock beyond the old position. Old watermarks, retry namespaces/keys, projection frontiers, cursors, handoff/resume handles, leases, and adapter acknowledgments must not bind to replacement history. Test both lost and surviving ledger rows, lost recovery anchors, and a crash midway through activation; reconciliation never blindly redispatches an external mutation.
